general.notes: Active Optical Cable (AOC) with integrated SFP28 connectors and cable; not a discrete optical transceiver. Forward Error Correction (FEC) is required in the host equipment per IEEE802.3bj. Without FEC, BER will be less than 5 x 10^-5. Electrical interface: SFF-8431 MSA compliant. Digital diagnostics via I2C. Power stated as low power, <1W (no single numeric watt value). Storage temperature -20°C to +85°C. Interconnect lengths 1m to 20m (up to 20m). Vendor identified via smartoptics.com footer only.
provenance_datasheet_sections: SFP28, 25G Ethernet, Active Optical Cable (AOC), 1m to 20m
general.suggestions: Datasheet lacks optical parameters (wavelength, TX/RX power, sensitivity) typical for AOCs; consider vendor supplement. Form factor is SFP28 in text but schema enum has SFF only—mapped to SFF. Explicit manufacturer name not in body; vendor taken from website reference.
